description: Export the contents of a plot to a file. Can create hardcopy images, convert to different file formats, or create data files to recreate the plot. If no plot name is specified, the current view is assumed. Default filename is 'flac3d_name' where 'name' is the plot name.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('plot export bitmap filename <path>') - no direct Python SDK method

keywords.name: bitmap
keywords.description: Renders the plot to a bitmap file. dpi/dpm set the dots-per-inch / dots-per-meter of the resulting file (default from the current video display). filename sets the destination file name; the extension determines the format (PNG default; PNG, BMP, PPM, XBM and XPM supported). size determines the bitmap size in pixels (default 1024 x 768). (Keyword name restored from the official 7.0 command index; a crawler artifact had collapsed it to 'size'.)

keywords.name: csv
keywords.description: creates a text file of data in CSV (Comma Separated Values) format, with data data from all plot items that support the conversion (e.g., charts, tables, etc.). This will be arranged in tabular form. This file can be easily imported into a spreadsheet progral like Excel, for further processing. The filename keyword can be used to specify the file output, which will have the CSV extension by default.

keywords.name: datafile
keywords.description: This command exports a data file that, if read with the program call command, should completely recreate the contents of the plot. The filename keyword can be used to specify the file output, which will have the F3DAT extension by default.

keywords.name: dxf
keywords.description: This command attempts to export the geometric contents of the plot as a DXF file. NOTE: The DXF format does not support all of the features used to generate a plot. Your results may differ substantially from the plot on the screen. The filename keyword can be used to specify the file output, which will have the DXF extension by default.

keywords.name: pdf
keywords.description: Creates a PDF file of the plot. filename sets the destination file name (default extension PDF). landscape selects landscape layout (default portrait). margin sets the page margins (inches or millimeters; default 0.25 all around). paper sets the paper size (default 11.0 x 8.5 in). size determines the size of the bitmap used to render the 3D image (default from the print image size setting; see the plot print-size command). (Keyword name restored from the official 7.0 command index.)

keywords.name: postscript
keywords.description: Creates a Postscript file of the plot; same layout keywords as pdf (filename default extension PS). (Keyword name restored from the official 7.0 command index.)

keywords.name: print
keywords.description: sends the plot to the operating system print system. If in interactive mode, this will open up a print dialog. If running as part of a data file, the plot will be sent to the default windows printer.

keywords.name: svg
keywords.description: Generates a Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) file of the plot. filename specifies the output file (default extension SVG). size specifies the size of the bitmap portion of the plot in pixels (default from the print image size setting; see the plot print-size command). (Keyword name restored from the official 7.0 command index.)

keywords.name: vrml
keywords.description: generates a VRML file representing the plot. This file can be viewed directly by a compatible application. For example, Adobe Acrobat 3D can be used to turn the resulting VRML into a PDF file, or to embed the VRML file into another PDF document. compress specifies whether the VRML file output will be compressed or in plain text (default false). filename specifies which file and path to give to the VRML file (default extension WRL). (Keyword name restored; 6.0 only.)

keywords.name: csv

keywords.name: datafile
keywords.description: This command exports a data file that, if read with the program call command, should completely recreate the contents of the plot. Sub-keyword enumerated live: filename. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

keywords.name: dxf
keywords.description: This command attempts to export the geometric contents of the plot as a DXF file. NOTE: The DXF format does not support all of the features used to generate a plot; results may differ substantially from the plot on screen. Sub-keyword enumerated live: filename. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

keywords.name: pdf
keywords.description: Creates a PDF file of the plot. filename sets the destination (default extension PDF); landscape selects landscape layout; margin and paper set page geometry; size sets the bitmap render size. Sub-keywords enumerated live: filename, landscape, margin, paper, size. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

keywords.name: postscript
keywords.description: DEPRECATED in 9.x: the keyword is still enumerated by the parser, but execution fails with 'Rendering to postscript is no longer supported'. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7. Use pdf or svg instead.

keywords.name: print
keywords.description: Sends the plot to the operating system print system (print dialog in interactive mode, default printer otherwise). Takes no further keywords in 9.x (live '?' probe returned an empty token list). Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

keywords.name: svg
keywords.description: Generates a Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) file of the plot. Sub-keywords enumerated live: filename, size. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.
